notes: LIVE Wowhead indexed item-side pooled Looter table (checked 2026-11-17; the search index was crawled six days earlier). higher-occurrence Eversinging Dust row; source shows 44 disenchants, row occurrence 33/44, displayed whole-% 75, displayed positive-stack range 1-3. Source is not a player-original zero-inclusive operation log, has no attributable gear itemLink, bonus, at-cast ilvl, build, skill, specialization, collector or output item ID/rank. Item page has generic ilvl 44 and a selected Adventurer 3/6 ilvl 227, NEITHER is verified at disenchant time. Two Eversinging Dust rows must remain distinct; DO NOT merge, assign ranks/IDs, infer per-cast stack histogram, total units or zero-yield operations. PTR 12.1.5 counterpart is overlapping mutable data (43 pooled with 32/9/2) and is NOT an independent cohort. Reference-only; never use as a measured study.
